freshness_window: 7d      # age after which a stamp is flagged for re-observation
chat_timeout: 600         # seconds an LLM chat call may take before giving up
max_generation_tokens: 8192  # safety rail: hard ceiling on tokens a chat call may generate

                          # reserves its own 32K default and ~10 GB. Refused below the
                          # derived floor; blank the value to leave it unpinned.
# backend: openai-compatible  # LLM backend family: "ollama" (default) or

                          # any server exposing /v1/chat/completions and
                          # /v1/embeddings). Selecting openai-compatible
                          # REQUIRES base_url below -- there is no packaged
                          # default endpoint for it, unlike Ollama's. An
                          # optional API key, if the server needs one, is read
                          # only from the OPENKOS_OPENAI_API_KEY environment
                          # variable -- never from this file.
# base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8080  # chat endpoint for the selected backend.
                          # UNSET by default: ollama then resolves OLLAMA_HOST
                          # or its own packaged default; openai-compatible has
                          # no default and refuses to start without this key.
# embedding_base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8081  # separate endpoint used only for
                          # embedding requests, for when the embedding model is
                          # served by a different process or port than the
                          # chat model. UNSET by default: embedding requests
                          # fall back to base_url (or that backend's own
                          # default).
# temperature: 0.2        # sampling temperature forwarded as options.temperature.
                          # UNSET by default -- unpinned, sampling follows whatever
                          # the model's Modelfile ships (qwen3:8b: 0.6). Pinning it
                          # REDUCES run-to-run variance; it does NOT guarantee identical

                          # determinism guarantee.
# volatility_windows:     # per-tier stale-stamp windows (overrides freshness_window
#   slow: 90d             # by knowledge-volatility tier; see docs/adr/0007)
#   volatile: 7d
# type_tiers:             # per-concept-type volatility tier overrides (overrides
#   Person: volatile      # the built-in registry default; see docs/adr/0007)
# type_sensitivity_defaults:  # per-type birth offset above `default_sensitivity`,
#   Person: 1             # in levels, clamped at confidential. Ships EMPTY --
                          # every type is born at the floor unless you say
                          # otherwise. Uncommenting the two lines above is the
                          # recommended setting if this workspace holds material
                          # about other people: a Person is then born one level
                          # above the floor. The high-water-mark over cited
                          # sources still wins whenever it is higher.
                          # See docs/adr/0015 and docs/adr/0017.

#   edge_typing: gemma2:27b  # every task follows `model:` EXCEPT `adjudication`
                          # and `contradiction`, which run on gemma4:26b-a4b
                          # (the judge model: `ollama pull gemma4:26b-a4b`;
                          # see docs/adr/0047). It does not fit in memory next
                          # to `model:`, so Ollama swaps them by stage. Opt out
                          # per task with `contradiction: null` (follows
                          # `model:`), or name another tag. The packaged judge
                          # applies on the ollama backend only. A missing judge
                          # fails only its own stage, naming the pull command.
                          # gemma2:27b is the one measured upgrade for
                          # edge_typing: it names relations better
                          # (0.81 vs qwen3:8b's 0.44 on evals/edge_typing/)
                          # but costs `ollama pull gemma2:27b` -- 15.6 GB.
                          # Uncomment BOTH lines above to opt in; uncommenting
                          # only one is invalid YAML. Keep it scoped to

                          # extraction path byte-for-byte

                          # model's own knowledge (default ON). Measured zero
                          # false refusals over 100 grounded checks. Costs one
                          # extra chat call per answered query (median ~1.1s
                          # against a default Ollama, which serialises); set
                          # false to remove it and restore the pre-#760 path
# revision_history: false  # attach each retrieved concept's earlier versions

                          # unset does NOT mean English: it means each item's

                          # concept type's (or that edge's) documents happen to
                          # dominate, so one report can mix English and Spanish
                          # rows. Set it to pin them to one language.
                          # Free-form -- the name is passed to the model
                          # verbatim, so a name it does not recognise is not an
                          # error: you get whatever it makes of it, visible in
                          # the very next curate table. Blank, multi-line and
                          # non-string values are refused.
                          # Setting it appends one sentence to both rationale
                          # prompts; leaving it unset sends the prompt that
                          # shipped, byte for byte, which is the configuration
                          # every measurement in evals/ was taken under.
                          # Affects those two rationales only -- extraction,
                          # query and adjudication still follow the source
                          # language, which is correct there.

#   max_calls_per_day: 500    # means all of them. Counted in chat calls; 0 means

                            # Must be an existing directory, never raw/, bundle/,

                            # file-notification wake-up to the daemon's idle wait
                            # (needs `pip install 'openkos[watch]'`; without it
                            # the daemon warns and polls). Polling still runs
                            # underneath, so no file is ever missed.
